changeSet.author: trendai
changeSet.comment: Migrate existing category data from trends table to categories table and populate trend_categories
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO categories (name, display_name, sort_order) SELECT DISTINCT category, category, 0 FROM trends WHERE category IS NOT NULL AND category != '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM categories c WHERE c.name = trends.category );

INSERT INTO trend_categories (trend_id, category_id) SELECT DISTINCT t.id, c.id FROM trends t INNER JOIN categories c ON t.category = c.name WHERE t.category IS NOT NULL AND t.category != '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trend_categories tc WHERE tc.trend_id = t.id AND tc.category_id = c.id );
